items.source_title: feat(browser): domain allowlist for automation commands
items.limux_native_design_note: Implement WebKitGTK browser command bridge parity with server-side domain policy and audit events.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches control_bridge, browser pane model, WebKitGTK lifecycle, and command authorization.
items.acceptance_sketch: Browser commands work through the GTK bridge only for allowed domains and rejected commands produce auditable errors.

items.source_title: Active agent indicator in sidebar
items.limux_native_design_note: Represent agent lifecycle in GTK sidebar rows without repainting the full list on every event.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Likely touches workspace sidebar model, notification routing, and CSS state classes.
items.acceptance_sketch: A workspace shows running, needs-input, idle, and unread states correctly with multiple panes.
items.notes: Combine with lifecycle color and sidebar invalidation work.

items.source_title: Workspace groups
items.limux_native_design_note: Design GTK sidebar grouping after core workspace state is stable.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Requires persistence, drag/drop rules, context menus, and compact row rendering.
items.acceptance_sketch: Users can group many workspaces and collapse groups without losing unread state.

items.source_title: Focus history and recently closed surfaces
items.limux_native_design_note: Add an event log for pane/workspace focus and close/restore operations.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches layout state, workspace selection, and tab/pane close flows.
items.acceptance_sketch: Recently closed panes can be restored and focus back/forward preserves workspace context.

items.source_title: Agent hibernation
items.limux_native_design_note: Research Linux-safe idle process throttling before any PTY/session mutation.
items.gtk_rust_implications: May involve process groups, PTY state, signal handling, and agent-specific resume semantics.
items.acceptance_sketch: Idle resource reduction never loses terminal state or leaves residual mouse/PTY modes.
items.notes: Research only; high risk for long-lived agent sessions.

items.source_title: Occluded surfaces with streaming output burn renderer CPU
items.limux_native_design_note: Benchmark hidden Ghostty/GTK surfaces and throttle redraws where visibility allows.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches terminal visibility, Ghostty frame scheduling, and workspace switch behavior.
items.acceptance_sketch: Hidden streaming panes do not consume excessive CPU and become current without stale frames.

items.source_title: Bound background-prime workspace mounts to fix main-thread stall with many agent panes
items.limux_native_design_note: Use bounded sidebar/list invalidation and avoid full workspace recomputation for background events.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches GTK list models, notification event fanout, and workspace row rendering.
items.acceptance_sketch: Many active agent panes do not freeze sidebar updates or main window input.
items.notes: Fold into scalable agent sidebar PRD.

items.source_title: Rescue split/new-tab cwd inheritance while a resumed agent holds the pane
items.limux_native_design_note: Resolve pane cwd from host/runtime state and Linux process data when foreground agent owns the terminal.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches pane creation, terminal environment, and session restore.
items.acceptance_sketch: Splitting from a resumed agent opens in the project cwd, not $HOME.

items.source_title: Preserve split layout in autosave fingerprint
items.limux_native_design_note: Persist split order, ratios, and pane identity in Limux layout state.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches layout_state, workspace persistence, and restore tests.
items.acceptance_sketch: Restart and workspace switching preserve split ratios and pane placement.
items.notes: Directly relevant to pane resize complaints.

items.source_title: Run file explorer git status without optional locks
items.limux_native_design_note: Any future file/sidebar Git probing should run read-only with optional locks disabled.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Mostly command environment policy; relevant to future file explorer or PR sidebar work.
items.acceptance_sketch: Git status observation never creates or waits on `.git/index.lock`.

items.source_title: Per-PR CI status in sidebar
items.limux_native_design_note: Only add GitHub/CI status after explicit auth, rate-limit, and privacy design.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Would touch sidebar metadata, background refresh, GitHub auth, and status caching.
items.acceptance_sketch: Linked PRs show current CI state without leaking tokens or freezing the UI.

items.source_title: Custom keyboard shortcuts for command palette commands
items.limux_native_design_note: Design GTK-native accelerator editor with conflict detection.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches settings storage, GAction accelerators, and shortcut conflict UI.
items.acceptance_sketch: Users can remap commands and conflicts are visible before saving.

items.source_title: Auto-color workspaces from cwd plus pane tinting
items.limux_native_design_note: Implement deterministic workspace/pane color flags without overriding unread attention state.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches sidebar CSS classes, workspace context menu, pane border rendering, and persistence.
items.acceptance_sketch: Manual and automatic colors coexist with unread blue outline and clear/off actions.
items.notes: Directly maps to operator-requested workspace/pane color flags.

items.source_title: Remote tmux/SSH persistence and recovery
items.limux_native_design_note: Research Linux-native SSH/tmux session management only after local runtime/session semantics are stable.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Likely new remote-session subsystem; avoid coupling to local pane code prematurely.
items.acceptance_sketch: Remote sessions survive reconnect and pane splits without corrupting terminal geometry.

items.source_title: fix(terminal): pass physical pixels to ghostty_surface_set_size on HiDPI
items.limux_native_design_note: Manually review upstream PRs #83/#100 and issue #82 against current fork terminal sizing.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches terminal surface size, GLArea/FBO dimensions, scale factor, and resize tests.
items.acceptance_sketch: Fractional scaling renders full terminal content without clipping on Wayland and X11.
items.notes: Prefer #83/#100 over duplicated #95 if patch review confirms.

items.source_title: fix: route dead-key compose through IMContextSimple on Wayland
items.limux_native_design_note: Harvest tests and design for dead-key/IME correctness without blindly merging input-path changes.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches keyboard event translation, IMContext handling, and Ghostty input delivery.
items.acceptance_sketch: Dead-key compose and IME input work on Wayland without regressing shortcut handling.
items.notes: Compare carefully with fork's keyboard regression fix.

items.source_title: fix(host-linux): make ctrl+w close the active tab, not the pane
items.limux_native_design_note: Review shortcut contract and implement active-tab close behavior if it matches fork UX.
items.gtk_rust_implications: Touches pane, terminal, window actions, and shortcut tests.
items.acceptance_sketch: Ctrl+W closes the intended tab and never accidentally destroys a workspace.
items.notes: Small candidate after shortcut contract check.

items.source_title: fix: prevent SIGABRT crash on split and fix send-key Return on bash prompts
items.limux_native_design_note: Inspect the closed unmerged patch and cherry-pick only if the bugs still reproduce.

items.acceptance_sketch: Splitting does not crash and send-key Return works on bash prompts.
items.notes: Closed unmerged upstream; verify before porting.

items.source_title: Running limux twice breaks the first window sock

items.acceptance_sketch: Starting two channel-isolated runtimes never causes the older one to lose copy/paste or control socket ownership.
items.notes: Fork has runtime-isolation work, but explicit two-live-runtime smoke coverage remains pending.

items.source_title: fix: harden Ctrl+click URL handling

items.acceptance_sketch: Font size persists per tab and survives restart without layout corruption.
